page.overview:
Who is Edi. E?

He uses his connections within the Mad Gears to gain information on rival gangs and uses his position as a police officer to arrest them, simultaneously furthering his own career and the goals of the Mad Gear Gang in one fell swoop. He is often seen ruthlessly pursuing Cody.

Edi. E is a tall, heavyset, middle-aged police officer with a beard. His uniform, which has the shirt collar unbuttoned to his chest, covers most of his body, thus making it difficult to accurately tell how much of his mass is fat and how much of it is muscle. Despite his build, Edi. E is a relatively good runner. He is often seen chewing a special gum with a "42910 points" flavor.

In addition to being corrupt and immoral, Edi. E is rather cowardly, as proven by the fact that he always carries a gun as well as a nightstick and never fights unarmed.

Edi. E is a corrupt police officer and was a top lieutenant in Belger's Mad Gear Gang, in charge of the city's West Side. When Mike Haggar's daughter Jessica was kidnapped by the gang, Cody encountered Edi. E outside a bar; depressed to see that Metro City was so corrupt that even police officers worked for the Mad Gears, Cody fought him and won, despite the advantage Edi. E had with his firearm. As a result of this loss, Edi. E developed a grudge against Cody.
